articles.title: American Cyclist Brandon McNulty Stuns Field to Win World Road Race Title in Montreal
articles.summary: Brandon McNulty became the first American since 1993 to win the men's elite road race world title, attacking with 33km to go in Montreal. He held off the chasers to finish in 6:17:04.

articles.title: Irish Teen's Eco Purge Invention Tackles Microplastic Pollution
articles.summary: Arya Satheesh, 18, developed Eco Purge — a plant-based plastic that decomposes while breaking down microplastics. She won $12,500 at The Earth Prize for her work.

articles.title: Why AI Isn't Ready to Pilot Spaceships — Yet
articles.summary: Space agencies use AI for Mars rovers and satellite safety, but today's AI is too unpredictable for full control. Researchers say humans must stay in the loop.
